06 / BEFORE YOUR TAKEDOWN

A few things
to know.

Have your service and hair condition in mind when choosing your appointment.

Can I book through a message?

All appointments must be booked through the website with the required deposit. Sending a message does not reserve your appointment.

How should I prepare?

Have your hair ready for removal. For home visits, provide a chair and a clear, well lit space.

Do you offer home visits?

Yes. Travel costs $1 per mile round trip, shown at checkout and paid upfront.

What if my hair is heavily tangled or matted?

Prices start at $120. Submit photos for a quote before booking. Any price changes require your approval before service begins.

Can I cancel or reschedule?

Please give 24 to 48 hours’ notice. The $25 deposit is nonrefundable.

Where is the appointment?

The appointment address will be sent by text after your booking and payment are confirmed.

Who can book a takedown?

Adults and children are welcome. Choose the service that matches the hairstyle being removed.

What styles do you remove?

We offer braid, weave and cornrow takedowns. Cornrows are priced separately depending on whether extensions are included. Frontal removal is not currently offered.

How long does a takedown take?

Time varies with the style, braid size, length and tangling. Photos help us assess the work and discuss the expected appointment time.

What if I have allergies to hair products?

Please list any product allergies or sensitivities on your booking form so we can discuss suitable products before your appointment.

Does the service include a wash or new hairstyle?

The service menu is for takedowns. A wash or new hairstyle is not included in the listed prices.
